nodes.title: Let the parent own the rating

anchor.snippet: function StarRating({ max = 5, rating, onChange }: StarRatingProps) {

nodes.why: StarRating draws whatever rating it receives and reports clicks and arrow keys through onChange, so the parent can show, store or reject a rating without the widget keeping a second copy.
nodes.alternative: Keep the rating in useState inside StarRating and report changes to the parent.
nodes.tradeoff: A local copy saves the parent one prop, but the two copies can disagree when the parent resets or loads a rating.

nodes.title: Give the group one Tab stop
nodes.why: A radio group is one stop in the Tab order: Tab lands on the checked star, or on the first star before anything is rated, and the next Tab leaves the group.
nodes.alternative: Leave every star in the Tab order.
nodes.tradeoff: Five Tab stops cost keyboard users four extra presses to get past the widget, and they behave unlike every native radio group.

nodes.title: Wrap the arrow keys at both ends
nodes.why: Right and Down add one and Left and Up subtract one; the modulo turns past the last star to the first and past the first to the last, as native radio buttons do.
nodes.alternative: Stop at the first and the last star.
nodes.tradeoff: Stopping is easier to reason about, but users who know radio groups expect the arrows to wrap.

nodes.title: Move focus with the rating
nodes.why: Focus moves to the star that was checked, so a screen reader announces the new rating and the next arrow press starts from it.
nodes.alternative: Change the rating and leave focus on the star that received the key.
nodes.tradeoff: Leaving focus behind is less code, but the focused star and the checked star then disagree and the next arrow press starts from the wrong place.

nodes.title: Check one star instead of pressing several
nodes.why: Only the selected star is checked, so assistive technology reads one choice, such as 3 out of 5, while the filled class still colors every star up to it.
nodes.alternative: Mark every filled star with aria-pressed.
nodes.tradeoff: aria-pressed describes toggle buttons, so a rating of 3 would be read as three pressed buttons.
